tool_schemas.name: get_report
tool_schemas.description: Runs a GA4 Data API RunReportRequest against the connected GA4 property using the specified Google credential, records the request in the audit log (using request_id for idempotency/traceability when provided), and returns either a cached response or the live Google response (no pagination beyond what the GA request itself specifies). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ga_property_id/credential_id/request_id fail their patterns, if required fields are missing, or if cache_ttl_seconds is negative; raises NOT_FOUND if the GA property or credential does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to use the property/credential; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when server or upstream Google Analytics limits are hit; and raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Google rejects the request or returns an error.

ga_property_id.description: ULID of the connected GA4 property to run the report against (ga_properties.id).

credential_id.description: ULID of the Google credential to use for the request (google_credentials.id).

request.description: Raw GA4 Data API RunReportRequest payload to proxy to Google Analytics Data API.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a cached response when available for the same request fingerprint.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Override cache TTL in seconds for this request; if omitted, the property default TTL may be used.

request_id.description: Optional request ULID to use for idempotency/traceability in the ga_requests log.

tool_schemas.name: get_realtime_data
tool_schemas.description: Runs a GA4 Data API RunRealtimeReportRequest against the connected GA4 property using the specified Google credential, records the request in the audit log (using request_id for idempotency/traceability when provided), and returns either a cached response or the live Google realtime response (no pagination beyond what the GA request itself specifies). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ga_property_id/credential_id/request_id fail their patterns, if required fields are missing, or if cache_ttl_seconds is negative; raises NOT_FOUND if the GA property or credential does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to use the property/credential; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when server or upstream Google Analytics limits are hit; and raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when Google rejects the request or returns an error.

ga_property_id.description: ULID of the connected GA4 property to run the realtime query against (ga_properties.id).

credential_id.description: ULID of the Google credential to use for the request (google_credentials.id).

request.description: Raw GA4 Data API RunRealtimeReportRequest payload to proxy to Google Analytics Data API.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a cached response when available for the same request fingerprint.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Override cache TTL in seconds for this request; if omitted, the property default TTL may be used.

request_id.description: Optional request ULID to use for idempotency/traceability in the ga_requests log.

tool_schemas.name: list_ga_properties
tool_schemas.description: Lists connected GA4 properties visible to the caller. Supports filtering by status and property_id, and returns paginated results ordered by created_at desc. Refuses requests with invalid pagination parameters (VALIDATION_ERROR).

property_id.description: Filter by GA4 property_id (the numeric/GA identifier stored in ga_properties.property_id).

page_size.description: Maximum number of properties to return in one page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list_ga_properties response.

tool_schemas.name: create_ga_property
tool_schemas.description: Creates a connected GA4 property configuration used by this server to route/cached Data API requests. Returns the created ga_properties row. Refuses creation when required fields are missing/invalid (VALIDATION_ERROR) or when a duplicate property_id already exists (ALREADY_EXISTS).

property_id.description: GA4 property identifier to connect (stored in ga_properties.property_id).

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for the property (e.g., "America/Los_Angeles").

default_cache_ttl_seconds.description: Default cache TTL in seconds applied when requests do not override cache_ttl_seconds.

status.description: Initial lifecycle status for the property; "deleted" cannot be set on create.

tool_schemas.name: update_ga_property
tool_schemas.description: Updates a connected GA4 property configuration, including lifecycle status transitions. Returns the updated ga_properties row. Refuses invalid updates (VALIDATION_ERROR) and rejects illegal status transitions per lifecycle (CONFLICT).

id.description: ULID of the ga_properties row to update.

time_zone.description: New IANA time zone for the property.

default_cache_ttl_seconds.description: New default cache TTL in seconds.

status.description: New lifecycle status. Allowed transitions: active->disabled/deleted; disabled->active/deleted; deleted cannot change.

tool_schemas.name: create_google_credential
tool_schemas.description: Registers a Google credential for use when proxying GA4 Data API calls for a specific connected property. Returns the created google_credentials row with secret material stored by reference. Refuses invalid payloads (VALIDATION_ERROR) and refuses creation if the referenced property does not exist (NOT_FOUND).

ga_property_id.description: Connected GA4 property ULID that this credential is bound to (google_credentials.ga_property_id).

credential_type.description: Credential type. Currently supports service account credentials.

project_id.description: GCP project_id associated with the credential (for display/diagnostics).

secret_ref.description: Reference to stored secret material (e.g., KMS/secret manager ref) used by the server to obtain access tokens; raw secrets are not accepted inline.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes the server will request when using this credential (e.g., https://www.googleapis.com/auth/analytics.readonly).

status.description: Initial lifecycle status; "revoked" cannot be set on create.

tool_schemas.name: update_google_credential
tool_schemas.description: Updates a Google credential record (e.g., rotate secret_ref, adjust scopes) and drives credential lifecycle transitions. Returns the updated google_credentials row. Refuses invalid updates (VALIDATION_ERROR) and rejects illegal status transitions per lifecycle (CONFLICT).

id.description: ULID of the google_credentials row to update.

secret_ref.description: New reference to stored secret material for rotation.

scopes.description: Updated OAuth scopes for this credential.

status.description: New lifecycle status. Allowed transitions: active->rotating/revoked; rotating->active/revoked; revoked cannot change.

last_validated_at.description: Timestamp of last successful validation; typically set by the server after validation.

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity as recognized by this server, including granted scopes/entitlements and current rate-limit/quota window consumption when an API key is used. Refuses when authentication is missing/invalid (UNAUTHENTICATED).

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller. When configured, the server validates it and returns associated limits and usage; may be omitted in deployments not requiring API keys.

metadata.name: Google Analytics Data API Server
metadata.description: This backend stores the configuration and operational telemetry for a server that proxies/serves Google Analytics Data API requests, specifically "report" and "realtime" retrieval. It tracks GA4 properties connected to the server, credentials used to call Google APIs, and an audit log of report/real
